info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Banking Human Resource Management Employee Certification By Employee Certification Id-v5-spec
info.description: The Employee Certification Management API facilitates the patching of employee certification information within the banking sector's human resource management system. This endpoint allows for the modification of existing employee certification details identified by their unique certification ID. Typical consumers include HR personnel and system administrators managing employee qualifications and compliance. By enabling timely updates to certification records, the API ensures that employees' credentials remain current and meet regulatory standards.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the certification details of a specific employee identified by their unique ID. This includes modifying various attributes associated with the employee's certification.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the employee certification details for the specific employee with ID EMP-900045. It should contain the necessary fields to modify the employee's certification status, dates, and relevant comments.
